title: Pīca et fīlius
summary: The walk with my son, the big hill, and a magpie with a plan. Iulia and Marcus.

intro.en: Today, let's talk about a walk, a little boy, and a magpie.
intro.la: Hodiē loquāmur dē ambulātiōne, dē puerō, dē pīcā.

lines.en: Marcus! Are you walking already?
Already. And not alone.
I'm walking with my son… with my son, yes.
lines.la: Cum fīlius… nōn: cum fīliō meō ambulō.

lines.en: With your son? How old is he?
lines.la: Cum fīliō tuō? Quot annōs nātus est?

lines.en: Three. So we walk slowly. Very slowly.
Is he holding your hand?
No. He's pulling a little pram.
A pram? Is there a baby in it?
lines.la: Currum puerīlem? Estne īnfāns in eō?

lines.en: No, it's empty. That's how he plays.
An empty pram. Unusual, but fine.
lines.la: Currus vacuus. Īnsolēns est, sed bene.

lines.en: Unusual? You talk like my teacher in the phone.
lines.la: Īnsolēns? Loqueris sīcut magistra mea in telephōnō.

lines.en: Your teacher? Is she good?
Very good. But she speaks too fast.
And she always says: in one go! Without a break!
lines.la: Et semper dīcit: ūnō impetū! Sine intermissiōne!

lines.en: Ha! Say it again, in one go.
Slower, please. Enough. Let's go on.
Fine. Where are you two going?
To the playground. Then I'll sit on a chair.
lines.la: Ad locum lūdōrum. Tum in sellā sedēbō.

lines.en: And he'll play for a little while.
Yes. And I'll rest. My whole body hurts.
lines.la: Ita. Et ego quiēscam. Tōtum corpus dolet.

lines.en: Why? Because of the walk?
No. Because of coffee. Too much coffee.
Ah. That's your own fault, then.
My own fault. Yes.
And later? Did you walk on alone?
Yes. My son stayed at home.
I walked up the big hill.
And then… how do you say it… a bird. Black and white.
lines.la: Et tum… quōmodo dīcitur… avis. Nigra et alba.

lines.en: A magpie!
Yes! A magpie. It followed me.
Really?
Really. It flew at my head.
Once, twice, three times!
I shouted, and I ran. Fast.
A big man runs away from a little bird!
Don't laugh! It's a real danger.
In spring in Australia, the magpies are angry.
lines.la: Vēre in Austrāliā pīcae īrātae sunt.

lines.en: Yes, because they have chicks.
Do you remember the kangaroo?
Of course! A week ago a magpie attacked a kangaroo.
lines.la: Certē! Ante hebdomadem pīca macropodem oppugnāvit.

lines.en: And you laughed.
I laughed. Today the magpie is laughing.
Almost right: today the magpie is laughing at you.
lines.la: Ferē rēctē: hodiē pīca tē rīdet.

lines.en: Thanks, teacher.
And now? Are you still on the hill?
lines.la: Et nunc? Adhūc in colle es?

lines.en: Yes, at the top. The magpie has left me.
lines.la: Ita, in summō. Pīca mē relīquit.

lines.en: Now my mind is becoming calm.
Calm. Good. Shall we go home?
Wait, I'm thinking… which road is safe?
lines.la: Exspectā, cōgitō… quae via tūta est?

lines.en: Not that one. The magpie is waiting there.
Then I'll walk home… slowly, like my son.
lines.la: Tum domum ambulābō… lentē, sīcut fīlius meus.

lines.en: Goodbye, Marcus! Watch your head!
